model_configuration: Uses existing OpenCode model; no API credentials or provider changes

options.max_cells: 1..100000, default 10000; shared budget across selected sheets
options.expected_source_sha256: Optional 64-hex digest from prior inspection; mismatch rejects before workbook parsing. Continuation/read_options include this automatically.

inspect.workflow: Inspect available_sheets first; then use sheets and start_row/start_col to retrieve later windows. Check requested/sample ranges and truncation. Cache freshness is never verified.

resource_limits.note: All budgets apply together. Larger/denser documents fail explicitly rather than silently parse partially.

output_notes.formula_records: formula_type and formula_metadata preserve normal/array/dataTable semantics; formula expression is text or null when none exists. Cached values are unverified.
output_notes.sheet_kind: worksheet has a cell grid; chartsheet has dimensions=null and no cell window, but chart/drawing relationships remain.
output_notes.library_warnings: Unsupported extensions/header/footer/etc warnings are captured. Omitted in-memory interpretation does not mean source file was modified.
output_notes.navigation: sheets[].page_id identifies snapshot/window/sample. sheets[].navigation.continuations[] and tail_read supply purpose, options, expected_source_sha256 and request_id. Call the same input with options directly. Finish partial-row/window requests before advancing; independent directions are not a single cursor.
output_notes.chart_sources: charts[].plots[].series[].{name,categories,values,x_values,y_values,bubble_size}.sources[] resolve explicit local A1 ranges to bounded source points with cell addresses, stored values/formulas, source_reliability, chart_cache_comparison and read_request.options. Named expressions, unions and external references remain explicit unresolved; no formula evaluation.
output_notes.cache_semantics: Cache point indices/gaps/empty states and multilevel_caches preserve hierarchy. Equality means stored representations only, never freshness. Truncated cache comparisons are not_comparable; source display truncation is explicit.
output_notes.summary: Readable summary aggregates chart-source comparisons, missing caches and actionable limitations; it does not imply unsampled cells were reviewed.
output_notes.error_values: Excel error cells and formula error caches remain explicit errors, not ordinary strings or verified numbers. Invalid/duplicate/out-of-range chart cache indices make comparisons not_comparable; no last-entry-wins inference.

spec.charts: Optional shared charts; each creates a ChartDataN sheet

sheet.name: Unique Excel sheet name
sheet.rows: 2D array of primitive cells or cell objects
sheet.header: boolean, default true; applies header-row styling to row 1
sheet.merges: Array of merge objects; overlapping populated cells are rejected

cell.format: header|integer|number|percent|currency|date|wrap|total; date is formatting of Excel serial numbers, not string-to-date conversion
cell.formula: Explicit allowed formula string, mutually used instead of value
cell.cached: string|finite number|boolean; caller-supplied and unverified; absent writes blank cache and marks recalc_pending

native_chart.title: optional text
native_chart.unit: optional Y-axis title for non-pie charts; not a number format
native_chart.anchor: optional Excel cell such as H2 (default H2)
native_chart.series: Array of 1..20 native_series objects; unknown fields are rejected

excel.limits: New files only. No existing workbook rewriting; no formula evaluation, macros or external links. No implicit stacked/secondary-axis options. Unknown fields are rejected at every spec/object level. Native pie requires one series.

merge.range: [r1,c1,r2,c2], zero-based inclusive within supplied rows; must span at least 2 cells
merge.value: optional text, default empty string; replaces upper-left value

validation.values: nonempty string array; total literal list length including separators <=255 characters; list validation only; commas and double quotes within individual values are rejected

native_series.name: optional literal text, not an Excel formula
native_series.categories: [sheet,r1,c1,r2,c2], zero-based inclusive one-dimensional range within supplied data; scatter X requires numeric values or explicit numeric formula caches
native_series.values: same format as categories and same length; scatter uses categories as X and values as Y; values must be numbers, blanks or pending formulas; pie requires known nonnegative numbers with positive total

excel.formula_functions: SUM AVERAGE MIN MAX COUNT COUNTA COUNTIF COUNTIFS SUMIF SUMIFS IF IFS IFERROR AND OR NOT ROUND ROUNDUP ROUNDDOWN ABS MOD INT SUBTOTAL SUMPRODUCT INDEX MATCH XLOOKUP VLOOKUP HLOOKUP LEFT RIGHT MID LEN TRIM CONCAT CONCATENATE TEXT DATE YEAR MONTH DAY EOMONTH TODAY

resource_limits.generation: 1..50 total sheets, <=100000 rectangular data cells, <=20 native charts per sheet, <=20 shared charts
resource_limits.inspection: 64 MiB archive, 128 MiB total expansion, 32 MiB per part, <=5000 members, <=200000 stored cells plus merged expansion, <=100 worksheets

excel.not_generated: Pivot tables, macros, embedded pictures, external links, stacked/combined/secondary-axis/date-axis charts, hidden sheets and existing-template edits are not generated. Their inspection support does not imply generation or fidelity support.

spec.title: required text
spec.subtitle: optional
spec.interaction: Optional static (default) | first-party-table. The latter embeds only the fixed local table search/sort runtime; no arbitrary JavaScript.
spec.title_lines: Optional array of 1..3 nonempty strings whose concatenation exactly equals title; semantic headline line breaks, escaped and responsive.

section_common.title: optional
section_common.width: full|half|main|rail, default full (12/6/8/4 columns; linear mobile/print fallback)
section_common.role: lead|evidence|aside|action|reference, default evidence; drives semantic hierarchy, not arbitrary positional styling

section_fields.table: headers:[string],rows:[[string|finite-number|boolean|null]],caption?; null renders blank, never zero; interactive?:boolean (default true only in first-party-table mode; true requires that mode)
section_fields.sources: items:[{id,title,publisher?,date?,note?,url?}]; unique ASCII ids; URL optional http(s) without credentials; never fetched or verified by engine

html.wide_tables: Tables with more than eight columns keep horizontal keyboard scrolling on screen and print as labeled records to retain every field.
html.unknown_fields: Rejected at spec, section, chart, series, KPI, timeline, board column, card and source levels; unsupported intent is never silently ignored.
html.examples: Use office_capabilities(topic=html, example=SCENARIO) for a complete runnable example.

args.output: new project-relative evidence directory; existing parent

validation.mode: Default static disables page JavaScript. first-party-table first inspects the same bytes with JavaScript disabled and accepts one exact fixed local runtime only, then uses a fresh context with independently enforced response-header hash CSP. All external requests blocked; Chromium sandbox requested without downgrade. Not an OS sandbox or source-identity authentication.
validation.artifacts: report.evidence filenames under evidence_directory; screenshot/PDF visual review required
validation.print: Default and open states each get separate layout budgets. Evidence PDF forced A4, 1-25 pages; reaching cap or uncertain page-object count is limited, never complete/pass. Native print pagination still needs visual review.
validation.interactive: Only deterministic table search, reset and stable sort are supported and checked. Unknown/duplicate scripts, event handlers, javascript URLs, embedded frames/objects, base, meta refresh, noscript and template are rejected; scripts cannot be added through tool parameters.

html.composition: Five scenario-specific reading structures share typography/spacing tokens. research adds real-title anchor navigation. Static table sections with role=aside,width=rail become complete labeled records; interactive tables remain tables. No data is dropped or invented.

shared_chart.title: text
shared_chart.semantics: bar is vertical in both outputs; pie requires exactly one nonnegative series with positive sum

outputs: Project-relative new filenames only; parent directory exists. Spec/options passed to tools as JSON strings. Always inspect generated Excel and run HTML QA before final delivery.
not_supported: PPT conversion (existing user skill remains separate)

args.query: 1..256 characters; concise English retrieval terms work best in the pinned catalog

design.workflow: Use installed office-visual-composition skill: brief, compare two content/layout plans, choose deliberate tokens, source/chart narrative, render, actual screenshot critique and revision. Local references inform decisions but never replace visual judgment.
design.outputs: Bounded local catalog matches with repository commit and CSV hashes; no-match is explicit. External font/CDN/asset loading fields are removed; system CJK fallbacks only.
design.limits: No persist, arbitrary paths, network, installers, external fonts, telemetry or automatic aesthetic score. visual_review stays pending-human-review until actual images are reviewed.

revision.workflow: Read embedded source, obtain input_sha256 and exact current scalar values; request explicit replacements into a NEW output; inspect changes, run office_validate_html and review screenshots again. No browser/script execution during extraction/revision.
revision.source: Non-executing versioned metadata in newly generated HTML. Hashes verify consistency, NOT author identity or trusted content. Legacy/missing/tampered metadata is unsupported; do not infer an original spec. Current engine must reproduce the complete file byte-for-byte; previous engine versions may be unsupported after upgrade.
revision.changes: JSON array of 1..32 {path,old,value}. Whitelisted existing content scalars only: top-level title/subtitle/eyebrow/period/footer/title_lines; section titles/body/caption; table headers/cells; KPI/timeline/source item content; chart title/unit/categories/series names/values; board titles/items. Same type and exact old value. Scenario, roles, widths, source IDs and interaction cannot change here. No duplicate/ancestor paths or structural edits.
revision.expected_input_sha256: Required exact current input SHA256 from office_read_html_source; stale input rejects before output write.
revision.limitations: Stored spec may contain source business text; sharing HTML also shares its embedded source. Existing files are never overwritten. Non-scalar restructuring requires full new spec and independent review.
